title: Saudi Arabian Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish popular in Saudi Arabian cuisine. This recipe combines the simplicity of rice with the richness of velvety spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the saúdi pilaf spices and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the velvety rice and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the arabian rice, salt, and black pepper. Stir well.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
